note: One district saw a leadership change this month; the other seven prospects were quiet on the administration front.

stories.headline: Highland names Ryan Erdelac interim superintendent
stories.body: The school board called a special meeting to accept Superintendent Brian Smith's resignation and named Assistant Superintendent Ryan Erdelac interim superintendent while a permanent search gets underway.

stories.headline: Superintendent Brian Smith departs Highland after 13 years
stories.body: Brian Smith resigned as Highland superintendent to become superintendent of Valparaiso Community Schools, ending a 13-year tenure and opening a permanent search at Highland.
